scope: Viewer-relative monotonic event seconds; recording manifest clocks are seconds from process launch, with a small initialization offset. Selected LOD/reasons and actual GPU draw-list membership, not measured shadow texel visibility.

motion-corrected.scope: monotonic seconds since viewer visual start; stream reason/LOD changes and actual GPU caster membership; does not infer shadow texel visibility

motion-settled-final.scope: monotonic seconds since viewer visual start; stream reason/LOD changes and actual GPU caster membership; does not infer shadow texel visibility
